name: Prompt engineer
summary: Writes and tests prompts that get reliable results from AI tools, from pulling data out of documents to brand-safe images.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources, model and API facts dated and taken only from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google docs, prompt injection from OWASP; four skills (prompt writing, extraction prompt and schema, test set and fix, image and video prompt sets); six prompts; two workflows; training interview and test briefs.
